dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: Governance rules and context were systematically loaded via 'rules-context-loader', followed by 100% schema validation success across all 12 reasoning spans under strict contract schemas.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The pattern-lifecycle flow executed a deep causal chain from context loading and dual-pattern extraction (agentic and structural) to signal proposals, scope classification, promotion workflow, and parallel reference architecture generations.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: Architectural trade-offs and scoping tensions were analyzed through dedicated pattern classification and promotion stages, with architectural implications synthesized across six reference architecture generations.
